patch.objective: Evaluating foundational movement patterns (bend-and-lift, single-leg, push, pull, rotation) through observation
secondaryObjectives: Applying exercise principles (specificity, overload, progression) to design personalized cardiorespiratory, muscular and movement programs

sources.cite: ACE Personal Trainer Exam Content Outline (2022 role delineation study; in effect since 2023-08-21): Domain 1 Client Interviews and Assessments 23% (health screening, medical clearance and referral); Domain 4 Professional Conduct, Safety and Risk Management 19%
sources.note: Read for the course on 2026-10-08 (backend/supabase/seed/tracks/fitness.ts); not re-read for this band. The objective titles are the course's own words.

sources.cite: NASM blog, How to Perform an Overhead Squat Assessment (OSA)
sources.note: Relevant text: five repetitions viewed from the front (feet, ankles, knees) and the side (LPHC, shoulder, cervical); compensations: feet flatten or turn out, knees move inward, low back arches, excessive forward lean, arms fall forward; knees moving inward is linked to 'decreased hip abductor and hip external rotation strength', 'increased hip adductor activity' and 'restricted ankle dorsiflexion'; with heels raised on a 2x4 or plates, knees in line suggest the foot and ankle, knees still in suggest hip weakness; 'lengthen overactive muscles and activate underactive muscles'. Read 2026-11-16 through a summarizing fetch; no date on the page. NASM's overhead squat solutions table (muscle lists) was not on the page and is not used.

sources.cite: ACSM Information On... Who Needs a Stress Test Before Exercising? (2017): warning signs 'Chest pain or pressure', 'Neck, jaw or arm pain', 'Shortness of breath', 'Unusual fatigue', 'Heart palpitations', 'Dizziness or a feeling like you are going to faint', 'Ankle swelling or overnight shortness of breath'; if they develop, 'discontinue exercise and seek a doctor's clearance right away'
sources.note: Read 2026-11-16 through a summarizing fetch. A consumer brochure; it does not say when to call emergency services, so the 911 step rests on the AHA page.

How much each corrective choice reduces the knees moving inward over four weeks, and the knee ache under load, are teaching simplifications, not measured effects. The direction follows the NASM page: the heel-raise retest separates the ankle from the hip, and the strategy is to lengthen overactive and activate underactive muscles.
